name: 1337 Wallet
tagline: A professional EVM signer for developers, hackers, and advanced users.
elevatorPitch: Self-custody signer: understand the request, judge the risk, sign or reject. RPC control, hardware, LiFi swaps, and a fast terminal UI — no 1337 accounts, no analytics, no central server. Not a Foundry or Etherscan lab.
audience: Power users who manage their own RPCs and chains
Anyone who wants a serious signer without wallet bloat

differentiators: Confirm-time human summary, local simulation, and contract danger flags
Side panel + popup, multi-RPC per chain, network doctor
Seed, private key, Ledger, and Trezor in one shell
LiFi swaps, multi-send, MetaMask-compatible dapp provider
Normal vs Instant signing modes for review or speed
Dark terminal aesthetic inspired by 1337 Skulls
notA: Not a hosted wallet — keys never leave your browser except to chains you broadcast to
Not an analytics product — we do not track how you use the extension
Not a Foundry, Hardhat, or Etherscan replacement — no ABI lab, storage inspector, or cast-style utilities
Not a burner-only toy — suitable as a serious daily driver when hardened (Normal mode, auto-lock, hardware)

privacy.summary: 1337 Wallet does not run analytics, does not phone home to a 1337 server, and does not create user profiles. Your vault, settings, and session live in Chrome extension storage on your machine.
storedLocally: Encrypted vault (seed / private keys) in chrome.storage.local
Wallet settings, custom RPCs, and chain preferences in chrome.storage.local
Unlocked session (active key metadata) in chrome.storage.session until lock or browser restart
networkWhenYouUseFeatures: Public RPC endpoints you choose (balances, sends, dapp reads)
LI.FI API when you open Swap or fetch routes (integrator id only; no 1337 server)
Optional Etherscan-compatible API key you paste in Settings (sent to the explorer provider for tx history)
Ledger / Trezor device SDKs and Trezor Connect when you use hardware accounts
Token logos and chain metadata from public HTTPS URLs (e.g. LI.FI catalog)
neverCollected: Browsing history beyond what Chrome grants for dapp connection
Wallet addresses or balances sent to a 1337 database

messaging.chromeExtensionDescription: 1337 — EVM signer for developers and power users. Readable confirms, local simulation, approvals, Ledger/Trezor, LiFi swaps, multi-RPC. No analytics. No 1337 server.
messaging.onboardingLead: A signer for developers and power users. Create or import a seed phrase or private key — encrypted locally with your password. Add Ledger or Trezor later in Settings.
messaging.settingsPrivacyLead: No analytics. No 1337 server. Everything below stays on your machine unless you initiate a swap, RPC call, or explorer lookup.
promoBullets: A signer first — readable confirms, not a disposable burner toy
Swaps, multi-send, custom RPCs, 20+ chains — no Foundry lab in the wallet
Hardware wallet support (Ledger WebHID, Trezor Connect)
Zero 1337 analytics or central account system
Open build — inspect the extension; verify before you trust

features: Multi-account HD seed and private-key import
Per-chain RPC picker and network doctor
Confirm-time human summary, local simulate, contract hints
Inspect address / token / ENS / tx before you sign or send
Token, NFT, and Permit2 approval revoke
Transaction history via your own explorer API key
